activation: Only generation > 0 after a verified local recycler transition; absent at generation zero.

fact_sources.objective: Digest and length of the unchanged task problem statement that is independently present in every request.
fact_sources.evidence: Only read observations confirmed by exact successful model request receipts through bindDelivery.
fact_sources.outcomes: Only closed projections of recorded tool-result events: read_file, recover_observed_read, search, list_files, apply_edits, get_patch, and rejected calls.

projected_fields: bounded result counts and paths for search/list_files
bounded diagnostics for rejected tool results
excluded_fields: claims of relevance, correctness, repair, completion, or test success not present in a tool result

bounds.token_limit: Caller-supplied finite measured limit; exceeding it fails instead of truncating unmeasured text.
bounds.eviction: Oldest outcome or evidence entry is removed deterministically, preferring the larger collection, until the byte cap fits.
bounds.empty_state: No presentation or tokenizer measurement occurs until at least one confirmed evidence handle or valid tool outcome exists.

integrity: projection_sha256 binds the complete fact material; verifyTaskStateProjection independently rebuilds from the same task, captures, receipts, events, generation and bounds.
measurement: The projection has no model-token cost while local. Its full rendered text is measured and counted whenever added to a model request.
claim_ceiling: Deterministic observed process-state candidate. It does not establish semantic relevance, useful retention, correctness, transfer, or benchmark benefit.
